task: Search for the next visible solar eclipse in North America and its expected date, and what about the one after that.
answer:
FINAL: As of October 27, 2026, the next solar eclipse visible from North America is August 2, 2027, followed by January 26, 2028.

• August 2, 2027: visible as a partial eclipse in eastern Canada and northern Maine; totality occurs elsewhere.
• January 26, 2028: visible as a partial eclipse in southern/eastern North America; the annular “ring of fire” occurs elsewhere.

Evidence: final.png shows Time and Date’s chronological list with “Solar Eclipses”, “North America”, and “Next 10 Years” selected, and both dates and visibility regions together: https://www.timeanddate.com/eclipse/list.html?region=north-america&type=solar

Time and Date confirms partial visibility in southern/eastern North America for January 26, 2028 (https://www.timeanddate.com/eclipse/solar/2028-january-26).
